basic_info.description: Welcome home to 1306 Funston Ave a rare opportunity in San Francisco's highly desirable Inner Sunset neighborhood! This 5BR, 2.5BA home offers incredible potential for buyers looking to renovate or reimagine a property in one of the city's most charming and walkable communities. Just a few blocks from Golden Gate Park, including the San Francisco Botanical Garden, Academy of Sciences and De Young Museum, the location is truly unbeatable. Enjoy being steps away from the vibrant Irving Street corridor with its many restaurants, cafes, and local favorites like Pineapple King Bakery and Tartine. The existing layout spans 3 levels: a lower level with garage, storage room, laundry, and half bath; a main level with a spacious living room, fireplace, dining room, kitchen, bedroom, and full bath; and an upper level with 4 additional bedrooms and a dual-vanity bathroom. Though the home is in need of some TLC, it presents a rare chance to create your dream residence in a beloved neighborhood with a 98 Walk Score. Don't miss this exceptional opportunity to bring your vision to life in one of San Francisco's most sought-after locations!
